limitations: All species are obligate, each has exactly one beneficial cyclic successor, and all other interactions are non-beneficial; only local strict-equilibrium stability and uniqueness conditional on existence are resolved. The result does not decide survival on limit cycles or global species extinctions.
scientific_integrity: An all-order analytic determinant-sign proof is supplied, with a separate exact-rational finite regression program; no independent validation or publication-priority certification is claimed.
title: Strict positive-real instability of obligate cyclic ecological communities
